text: Your elevator doesn't hang from one cable. It hangs from several, and any one of them could hold the loaded car.
They run over a wheel at the top, down to a counterweight, so the motor barely has to lift.
And if the car ever goes too fast, a spinning wheel called the governor trips a clamp.
That jams steel wedges against the rails, and the car squeezes to a stop.
And springs in the pit catch anything left.
So what happened the one time all of it failed? Full video on my channel.
